summary: The checkpoint of the deployment weeks: one workflow with four jobs (Python with a real database, gateway, page, and the three images behind them), a first push and a first log, a red run on purpose, a badge, and a README that says what CI checks and what it does not. The workflow was never run on GitHub and no image was ever built, so your first run is the real one.
goal: M13 checkpoint: a green badge in the README.

items.text: Create ci.yml, lint it and run each job's commands by hand
Push a branch, open a pull request and read the log of the slowest job
Fix the first red run from the first error in its log
Make a red run on purpose, see which job is grey, then make it green
Add the badge and the README section with what CI checks and does not check
Run git grep -n -i password and read every line
Play the Pipeline Check game to the end and see your score
